links.outcome: Extraction and timeline task performance with targeted retrieval versus recent-notes long-context input
links.effect: For Imaging Procedures, RAG exceeded long-context performance by 0.17-9.83 F1 across models using <8K tokens; for Antibiotic Timelines, <8K retrieved tokens matched long-context (-3.26 to +3.24 Jaccard); Diagnosis Generation static.
links.quote: For Imaging Procedures, RAG strongly outperformed recent-note inputs and exceeded long-context performance (by 0.17-9.83 F1 across all models) using fewer than 8K tokens.

links.outcome: Effect of missing patient data in notes on task performance
links.effect: Error analysis found missing information in the clinical notes, often due to inter-hospital transfers, limited performance to some extent.
links.quote: Error analysis revealed that missing information in the clinical notes-often due to inter-hospital transfers-limited performance to some extent.
